title: Finite Instructions and Solenoidal Shear Flows
summary: We realize finite reciprocal affine instruction maps by smooth incompressible shear flows on a flat three-torus. Applied to a reversible one-head recorder with a finite transition table, this gives a complete machine-to-fluid construction: a fixed particle enters a fixed open strip exactly when a given machine halts, with zero initial velocity, zero pressure, and a solenoidal mean-zero force that is periodic after initialization.
